Ref.description: Load voltage reference; follow load return

BUS-IN.description: Engineering identifier for upstream bus connector

BUS-OUT.description: Engineering identifier for downstream bus connector

modelingNotes: One switching pole, 25 A nominal variant, operating range 42-660 VAC; installation derating and protection remain application-specific.
No A1/A2 external command terminals for this proportional P variant. BUS-IN/OUT are engineering aliases. Ref is a logical reference connection; duplicated physical connection points are not expanded.
Power symbol and detailed SSR behavior are not implemented by this library. No implicit load continuity.

connectionCoverage.notes: Logical line, load and reference connections only. Duplicated physical reference connection points and internal bus power are not expanded.
